title: niobe -p --json
description: One turn run with no terminal: how it ended, the agent's reply, and what it spent, in the fields cost.schema.json names a session's spend by. Nothing in it is an estimate. A field is added without moving schema_version; it moves when one changes meaning or goes away.

outcome.description: How the turn ended. Each has its own exit status: finished 0, failed 1, budget_stopped 3.

reason.description: Why the turn did not finish, in the backend's words; null where it finished.

reply.description: The session's last reply of its own, as the agent wrote it; empty where it wrote none.

session.description: The number `niobe --resume` carries the session on by, or null where the store kept none of it.

started_at.description: When the prompt was sent, RFC 3339 in UTC to the second.

windows.description: Where the plan's usage windows stood when the turn ended, as shares used — 0.33 is a third gone — or null where the backend reported none, as a metered profile never does. A window left out of the report is null, never a zero.
